day.headline: A Snake day — Ox and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Rooster and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: something a child could explain better
signs.message: Say it in one plain sentence. Nobody needs the jargon version.

reasons: Ox and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a bin that needs going out
signs.message: Kitchen's about to start smelling. Haul it out before you head off.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It started early, so ride it. Say yes to tonight.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Shoulders up by your ears again. Go to the class.

reasons: Monkey pairs with Snake — a harmonious day
signs.message: One load, started now. Dry by the time you're back.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a morning that already feels behind
signs.message: Not behind, just later. Pick one thing, start with that.

reasons: Pig opposes Snake — a day to take slowly
signs.message: You quit asking. Ask once more, plainly, then let it go.

reasons: Snake's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Fourth time buying that same shade. Wear the three you own.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It was asked casually. Say no just as casually, no essay.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: They moved it last minute. Don't sprint, catch the next one.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Step over that heap one more evening. It waits fine.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You'd happily make it again. Not tonight, keep the recipe.
